Request:
An online store where customers browse products, add them to a cart, and check out with a credit card. Admins can add and remove products and see order history.

Plan "Online Store":
frontend:
- Product Catalog: Browsable, searchable list of products.
- Cart & Checkout: Cart contents and a checkout flow that collects payment info.
- Admin Product Panel: Lets an admin add, edit, and remove products.
backend:
- Catalog API: Read endpoints for products; write endpoints restricted to admins.
- Orders API: Creates orders from a cart and records payment status.
- Payment Gateway Adapter: Talks to an external payment processor to charge a card.
database:
- products table: Stores product name, price, and stock count.
- orders table: Stores order id, customer id, line items, and payment status.
security:
- Admin-Only Write Guard: Rejects product create/edit/delete from non-admin users.

Request:
Build a task management app for small teams. Users sign in with email and password. Each team has boards, boards have columns, columns have cards. Team members can drag cards between columns. Only team members can see or edit a team's boards.

Plan "Team Task Board":
frontend:
- Board View: Shows columns and draggable cards for one board.
- Login Page: Collects email and password and starts a session.
- Team Switcher: Lets a user switch between teams they belong to.
backend:
- Boards API: CRUD for boards, columns, and cards, scoped to team membership.
- Auth Service: Issues and verifies session tokens on login.
database:
- boards table: Stores board id, team_id, and title.
- cards table: Stores card id, column_id, text, and position.
- team_members table: Maps user ids to team ids.
security:
- Team Membership Check: Rejects any board/card access from a user not on that team.

A multiplayer trivia game where players join a room with a code and answer questions in real time.

Plan "Real-Time Multiplayer Trivia":
frontend:
- Trivia Lobby: Room-code entry and player list.
- Question Timer: Counts down to the next question.
- Answer Entry Box: Lets a player submit an answer.
backend:
- Trivia Game Engine: Runs a round per room, checking answers against the correct answer.
- Realtime Room Sync: Synchronises player counts and question state across all connected clients.
database:
